## XDRIVE and inbound source filtering

- Added XDRIVE for VLESS clients and servers, preserving nested storage templates, two-step operations and XMUX settings through JSON imports and share links.
- Added the matching VLESS encryption/decryption fields and automatic client Mux required by XDRIVE. HTTP/3 is selected with TLS and ALPN `h3`.
- XDRIVE bypasses the TCP prefilter during automatic selection so an unrelated host/port check cannot discard a working storage transport.
- Added Finalmask allowlists and blocklists for incoming TCP/UDP connections on Xray servers, including IPv4/IPv6 CIDR ranges.
- Improved Persian logging and update download labels.

XDRIVE requires Xray 26.10.22 or newer. Inbound source filtering requires Xray 26.10.21 or newer. Configuration generation, a local XDRIVE data transfer and TCP/UDP filtering are tested against Xray 26.10.22.
